messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take levothyroxine exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Some brands of levothyroxine have different dosage instructions and/or recommendations of how soon you need to take them before eating food. Always check the instructions on the label.
Oral levothyroxine:
Oral levothyroxine is taken by mouth and is available as tablets, capsules, and an oral solution.
- Keep using this medicine even if you feel well. It may take 4 to 6 weeks to get the full benefit of a dose.
- You will need frequent medical tests, and your next dose may be delayed based on the results.
- This medicine can affect the results of certain medical tests. Tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine.
- Tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery or dental procedure.
- Taking more than your recommended dose will not make this medicine more effective, and may cause serious side effects.
Tablets and capsules:
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "requires patient notification to", "doctor before surgery or dental procedure"]

The relation 'requires patient notification to' in the triplet is defined as 'The patient using the subject drug must inform the specified healthcare provider of their use of the medication.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires patient to inform providers of': The patient taking the subject drug must disclose the specified medications to their healthcare providers.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires decision with': A decision regarding the use of the subject drug or the feeding method should be made jointly with a healthcare provider.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
